topics.definition: Sentiment analysis determines the emotional tone or opinion expressed in text.
tips: Use domain-specific training data when possible.

topics.definition: Positive sentiment expresses favorable opinions or emotions.
tips: Look for positive opinion words in context.

topics.definition: Neutral sentiment expresses facts or balanced statements without strong emotion.
Negative sentiment expresses unfavorable opinions or emotions.
Emotion detection identifies emotions such as joy, anger, sadness or fear.
tips: Emotion classification is more detailed than sentiment analysis.

topics.definition: Aspect-based sentiment identifies opinions about specific features or aspects.
topics.example: Camera is great but battery is poor.

topics.definition: Sentiment models are evaluated using metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall and F1-score.
Use balanced datasets, handle sarcasm and validate model performance regularly.
